meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2025
meetings.summary: As the first item on today’s agenda, the committee decided on a deadline to complete the Housing Bill proposed by Central Mafannu constituency member Asma Rasheed. Once the chair opened the floor for members, Vilimale' constituency member Mohamed Ismail proposed to set 15th June 2025 as the deadline to complete all the work related to the Housing bill in the committee stage. It was seconded by North Galolhu member Mohamed Ibrahim. All the members present in the meeting unanimously passed to set 15 th June 2025 as the deadline to complete Housing Bill. After that, the committee discussed how to proceed with the bill. Once the chairperson opened for members' opinion, Vilimale' constituency member Mohamed Ismail proposed to open for public comments for a period of 10 days. It was seconded by North Galolhu member Mohamed Ibrahim. All the members present in the meeting unanimously passed to open for public comments for a period of 10 days. As the last item, the committee discussed how to get suggestions or opinions from stakeholders. Once the chairperson opened for members’ suggestions, South Hithadhoo constituency member Ibrahim Nazil proposed that the committee secretariat handle all the administrative tasks related to gathering opinions from stakeholders. It was seconded by Vilimale' constituency member Mohamed Ismail. All the members present in the meeting unanimously passed that the committee secretariat handle all the administrative tasks related to gathering opinions from stakeholders.

meetings.title: 2nd Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: The first item on today’s agenda is to set the working quorum for the summoned meetings stipulated in section 184 (a) of the standing order of the People’s Majlis. Once the chair opened the floor for members, Central Maafannu Constituency Member Asma Rasheed proposed to set 7 members as the working quorum for such meetings as stipulated in section 184 (a) of the standing order of the People’s Majlis. It was seconded by Central Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr. The members present in the meeting unanimously passed the working quorum for the summoned meetings as 7 members. As the second item on the agenda, the committee discussed an administrative procedure for approving other matters submitted to the committee apart from the issues submitted under section 172 (a) of the People’s Majlis. After discussing the matter, the chairman announced that the matter will be rescheduled for the next meeting, as there are certain things the committee needs to clarify from the secretariat.

attendance.name: Deciding an administrative procedure for approving other matters Completed

meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: The agenda for today's meeting was to elect the Chairperson and the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. Director, Legal Affairs, Afzaal AbdulSattar conducted the selection of the Chairperson and the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. Vilimale’ Constituency Member Mohamed Ismail proposed to elect Inguraidhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Falah as the Chair of the Committee. It was seconded by South Hithadhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Nazil ަ and and Inguraidhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Falah was elected unanimously as the Chairperson of the Committee. As for the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee, Central Machangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr proposed South Henveyru Constituency Member Hussain Imran Latheef, and was seconded by South Hithadhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Nazil and South Henveyru Constituency Member Hussain Imran Latheef was elected unanimously as the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. The meeting was then presided by the Chairperson of the Committee. Furthermore, the committee discussed the working quorum and the voting quorum of the committee. The Standing Order states that the working quorum of a committee shall not be lower than 1/3 of its members. When the Chairperson opened the floor for the members, South Hithadhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Nazil proposed the working quorum of the committee as 6 members. It was seconded by Vilimale’ Constituency Member Mohamed Ismail and was passed unanimously. Lastly, the working quorum of the committee was discussed. Vilimale’ Constituency Member Mohamed Ismail proposed the voting quorum of the committee as 7 members. It was seconded by Central Machangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr and this proposal was passed unanimously.
